close_reason: fixed: build_email_from_create has comment block listing unimplemented fields, citing JMAP-wgbh
description: email.rs build_email_from_create extracts mailboxIds, keywords, subject, inReplyTo, references, receivedAt from the create payload but silently drops from, to, cc, bcc, sender, replyTo, messageId, and bodyStructure/textBody/htmlBody/attachments after validation. The body structure is validated (partId/blobId checks) but never attached to the stored Email object. Clients submitting a full Email create payload get a stored object missing all envelope and body fields. Maintenance consequence: spec compliance gap that is invisible from the API (no error returned); future implementors assume 'if validation passes, fields are stored'.
title: Email/set create silently drops from/to/cc/bcc/sender/replyTo
